definitions.gloss: potato, taro, yam, tuber, root vegetable
definitions.explanation: A general term for starchy root vegetables. Context usually clarifies which type (さつまいも, じゃがいも, さといも, etc.).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芋|いも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{採|と}れる→採る：20862_toru⟧。
examples.english: A lot of potatoes are harvested in this region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芋|いも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Autumn is the season when potatoes are delicious.

notes:
{芋|いも} is a general term for starchy tubers and root vegetables. On its own, which type it refers to depends on context and region.

TYPES:
- ⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧: potato
- ⟦さつまいも→さつまいも：10339_satsumaimo⟧: sweet potato
- さといも: taro
- やまいも / ⟦{長芋|ながいも}→長芋：24129_nagaimo⟧: yam, mountain yam
- ⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧いも: konjac

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芋|いも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧: to dig up potatoes
- {芋|いも}{掘|ほ}り: potato digging (autumn activity for children)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{芋|いも}→焼き芋：15650_yakiimo⟧: roasted sweet potato (winter street food)
- {芋|いも}けんぴ: fried sweet potato snack

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{焼|や}き{芋|いも}→焼き芋：15650_yakiimo⟧ (roasted sweet potatoes) are a beloved autumn/winter treat, traditionally sold from trucks that drive through neighborhoods. {芋|いも}{掘|ほ}り (potato digging) is a popular autumn outing for kindergartners and families.

WRITING:
Also written as イモ in katakana, especially in compound names for plants.
